purpose: Teach: よら/云っ/よろしけれ/ぶち/つぶれ/とどまら/創る/ココロ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが今日はよらない用事があったみたい
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he had something come up today and won't be able to make it.
lines.style: Gentle opener, slightly concerned. Soft pace. Warm tone that reassures even as she delivers the news. Trailing off slightly as if weighing how he'll take it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが「ありがとう」と云って下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad said thank you to me today.
lines.style: Bright and genuine, eyes widening slightly. Quick, eager delivery. Pride in the accomplishment—not boastful, but quietly pleased with himself. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはよろしければ夕飯を一緒に頂きたいわ
lines.en: Sho, if you'd like, I'd love to have dinner with you tonight.
lines.style: Warm, genuine offer. Slow, deliberate pacing. Slight lift at the end—an invitation, not an obligation. Tender undertone, making space for him to say yes or no.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、感情をぶち撒けず冷静に話したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I kept calm and talked about my feelings without losing it.
lines.style: Proud but not showy. Steady voice, measured pace. There's quiet strength here—he's telling her about a real effort. Slight emphasis on 'calm' like it cost him something.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達のお店がつぶれたって聞いたわ
lines.en: Sho, I heard that your friend's shop closed down.
lines.style: Soft, sympathetic opener. Slight pause before speaking, as if choosing words carefully. Quiet tone—not sad, but present to the weight of it. Waiting to see how he responds.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、現状にとどまらないでがんばるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to keep moving forward instead of staying where I am.
lines.style: Determined but gentle. Steady, even pace. There's resolve here—not desperate, but grounded. Voice carries quiet confidence. Slight emphasis on 'forward' like he's made a decision.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと特別な思い出を創るのが楽しみね
lines.en: Sho, I'm looking forward to making special memories with your dad.
lines.style: Tender, genuine warmth. Slow, thoughtful pace. Voice softens on 'special memories.' There's affection here—for Sho, for the moment, for what's coming. Almost dreamlike in its contentment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんへのココロのお礼を伝えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I told Dad thank you—from the bottom of my heart.
lines.style: Quiet and sincere, voice nearly trembling with emotion held in check. Slow delivery. The words carry weight—this mattered to him. Trailing softly at the end, like a confession.
